I have completed the visual design review of bainluck.com. 

I captured full-page desktop screenshots of the 7 requested pages, as well as mobile screenshots for the home feed, live event, and championship grid. I also reviewed the competitor sites (DataGolf and FanDuel) to benchmark chart quality and data density. 

The comprehensive Visual Design Review Report has been generated and attached, scoring each page across your specified dimensions and providing prioritized, actionable improvements. The original screenshots are also attached for your reference.

Bain Luck's editorial pages (Economics and Weather) are particularly strong, successfully bridging the gap between raw data density and consumer-friendly polish. The primary areas for improvement are standardizing the Home Feed's visual rhythm and significantly increasing the data density on the Championship Grid.
